headline: X replaces its revenue-sharing program with ‘Original Content Rewards’
summary: X is ending its previous creator revenue-sharing program. A new 'Original Content Rewards' program launches September 8th. Creators need 500+ verified followers and 500k+ Home Timeline impressions to be eligible.

headline: Amazon data center linked to potential worst polluting power plant in US
summary: Amazon is investing in a new gas-burning power plant for its West Texas data center. The plant could become one of the largest greenhouse gas producers in the US. This raises environmental concerns about tech infrastructure expansion.

headline: Buc-ee’s sued another small business after John Oliver dared them
summary: Buc-ee's has a history of suing small businesses over branding. John Oliver publicly challenged the company to sue him on his show. Instead of Oliver, Buc-ee's initiated another lawsuit against a different small business.

headline: Musician Tom Vek creates new digital music player, rejects 'retro' label
summary: Musician and entrepreneur Tom Vek is developing a new digital music player. He emphasizes it's a modern device, not a retro comeback. The project aims to innovate how users interact with digital music.

headline: Mortal Kombat Director Unsure About Return for Third Movie
summary: Mortal Kombat movie director Simon McQuoid has expressed uncertainty about his return. The development of a third Mortal Kombat movie remains in limbo. Fans await news on the future of the film franchise.

headline: Freddy Fazbear's Pizza to open permanent real-world location
summary: Freddy Fazbear's Pizza from 'Five Nights at Freddy's' will open a permanent real-world location. The restaurant will feature animatronic stage shows. It's scheduled to open in 2027 at the American Dream entertainment complex.

headline: Doom Dev Slams Xbox Leadership After id Software Layoffs
summary: Lead services programmer Chris Hays criticized Xbox after layoffs at id Software. Hays stated Xbox leadership 'fundamentally don't understand art.' His comments highlight ongoing tensions within the industry post-acquisitions.

headline: Daily Deals: AirPods Pro 3, LEGO Back to the Future, Saros, and more
summary: Find the best deals today on popular tech and gaming items. Featured discounts include AirPods Pro 3 and LEGO Back to the Future sets. Discover savings on electronics, collectibles, and more.

headline: Andy Burnham to launch UK cost of living tour
summary: Andy Burnham is embarking on a UK tour to address the cost of living crisis. No 10 claims the prime minister's plans will 'give people some room to breathe.' Opposition figures, including Burnham, accuse the government of 'hypocrisy'.

headline: Fifa criticises campaign to oust president Gianni Infantino
summary: Fifa strongly criticized a 'concerted and ongoing effort' to 'undermine' the organization. The campaign is aimed at ousting Fifa president Gianni Infantino. Fifa defends its leadership against these efforts.

headline: PC Andrew Harper's death resonates as killers face early release
summary: PC Andrew Harper's death, just a month after his wedding, has resurfaced. The early release of two of his killers has sparked public outcry. The case continues to deeply resonate with the public.

headline: Israel accused of 'weaponising archaeology' in West Bank
summary: Israel is accused of 'weaponising archaeology' at ancient West Bank sites. The country plans large-scale land expropriations in historic Palestinian areas. Critics argue this move solidifies control over disputed territories.
